verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance is a SaaS platform that stores customer entity, license, tax and corporate records, so retention and deletion controls are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no retention policies, retention periods, account or data deletion workflows, or privacy-posture controls. The only related item is that API resource deletion needs capabilities Harbor must explicitly grant, which is generic CRUD permissioning rather than user-controlled data retention or deletion.
